answer: In an agent economy, Sybil resistance can rely on time-locked staking bonds where each identity posts collateral that remains frozen beyond the operational horizon. An attacker seeking multiple fake agents must lock proportional capital, making large-scale forgery costly; any proven collusion triggers slashing that erodes the saffron-colored reserves of the malicious pool. This velvet-gloved enforcement keeps honest participation cheap while raising the barrier for coordinated identity spam.
